Final real fixtures explicitly constrain DNS to their IPv4 listener; production defaults and deadlines are unchanged. The default dual-stack cross-host behavior is unresolved, not a production qualification.

The first TLS local fixture overflowed the Windows stack. Multiple peer fixtures now use caller-owned heap storage. A mechanical fixture pointer correction then passed; all development diagnostics remain.
Whole-root standalone probe initially lacked the core include directory in its compiler command. Corrected harness only; both original failures and successful root-selector consumers remain.

Early v1 successful functional binaries were superseded by v2 artifact paths; original log hashes, executable hashes and reconstructible inputs remain. All final shipping-v2 and test-v3 functional executables are retained and checked. The failed v1 real executable is retained exactly.
